product_lineage.devicex: SDX installed on specific hardware — branded appliance (Branch-in-a-Box, School-in-a-Box)
product_lineage.stackx: Management, orchestration, observability, automation, ITSM, compliance, and SOC platform layer above/around DeviceX/SDX

devicex_sdx.description: Capability modules for the site edge. SD-WAN is the core; the others are optional add-ons.

modules.name: SD-WAN
modules.summary: Resilient, quality-steered wide-area connectivity over any mix of access services.
modules.notes: Core module — include in every DeviceX proposal unless SD-WAN is not required.

modules.name: Firewall
modules.summary: Stateful or next-generation firewall with in-site micro-segmentation.
modules.notes: Base stateful firewall or the enhanced next-generation variant — choose per bid.

modules.name: SASE / Zero Trust Access
modules.summary: Identity- and device-aware access control at the site edge.

modules.name: Network Services (DNS, DHCP, LDAP, RADIUS)
modules.summary: Core network services delivered on the appliance at each site.

modules.name: NVR / Video Surveillance
modules.summary: Local video recording with central monitoring and optional edge analytics.
modules.notes: Two variants: without analytics, or with edge analytics — choose per bid.

modules.name: IP-PBX / Unified Communications
modules.summary: Site telephony with call routing, IVR, recording and local survivability.

modules.name: Virtualization / Container Platform
modules.summary: Virtual machines and containers hosted at the site edge.

modules.name: Business Workloads Hosting Platform
modules.summary: Managed hosting for business-critical applications.

modules.name: DeviceX/SDX Centralized Operations
modules.summary: Central provisioning, policy and monitoring of every appliance, with zero-touch provisioning and attestation.

stackx.group: StackX — Control / Orchestration / SOC / Operations Layer
stackx.description: Capability modules for IT operations, service management and security.

modules.name: StackX TrueView
modules.summary: Business and technical service dashboards that correlate data across systems.

modules.name: StackX Observability & APM
modules.summary: Metrics, logs and traces with anomaly detection and application performance monitoring.

modules.name: StackX Operations Monitoring & Configuration Management
modules.summary: Automated discovery, CMDB and consolidated event management across the IT estate.

modules.name: StackX Network Operations
modules.summary: Network fault, availability and performance management with root-cause analysis.

modules.name: StackX Event & Log Management
modules.summary: Central collection, retention, search and analysis of logs and events.

modules.name: StackX ITSM
modules.summary: ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request management with a service portal.

modules.name: StackX Automation & Orchestration
modules.summary: No-code automation of multi-vendor devices and end-to-end workflows.

modules.name: StackX Endpoint Management & Analytics
modules.summary: Inventory, software distribution, remote management and user analytics for endpoints.

modules.name: StackX Identity Management (IDM)
modules.summary: Identity lifecycle, role-based access control and directory integration.

modules.name: StackX Backup
modules.summary: Scheduled, incremental backup with fast recovery and immutable copies.

modules.name: StackX Security
modules.summary: SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, network and threat intelligence capabilities for detection and response.
modules.notes: The security platform. Add StackX SOC Operations when Verto Wave also runs the security operations service.

modules.name: StackX Compliance Assurance
modules.summary: Continuous configuration and vulnerability assessment with audit-ready compliance evidence.

modules.name: StackX Operations Integrity
modules.summary: Configuration baselines, drift detection and controlled, verified access to IT operations.

modules.name: StackX SOC Operations
modules.summary: Security monitoring and incident response operated by Verto Wave on the StackX platform.
modules.notes: A managed service: included only when managed services are part of the offering.

modules.name: StackX DevOps Framework
modules.summary: A governed release pipeline from development to production with digital change records.

modules.name: StackX Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)
modules.summary: Performance and functional test automation for applications before release.

modules.name: StackX Call Center Management
modules.summary: Omnichannel contact center with skills-based routing, IVR and quality management.

opentext.description: OpenText products Verto Wave implements. Each is described by function alone unless the proposal names vendors.

modules.name: Service Management Platform
modules.summary: Service desk, incident, request, change, problem, release and service-level management.

modules.name: Configuration Management and Discovery
modules.summary: Automated discovery, dependency mapping and a governed configuration management database.

modules.name: Event Correlation and Root-Cause Analysis
modules.summary: Consolidates events from every monitoring source, suppresses noise and presents a probable cause.

modules.name: Network Operations Management
modules.summary: Network discovery, fault and performance monitoring across the routed and switched estate.

modules.name: Runbook Automation and Orchestration
modules.summary: Automated runbooks and orchestration flows triggered by the service desk or by monitoring.

elastic.description: Elastic products Verto Wave implements. Each is described by function alone unless the proposal names vendors.

modules.name: Server and Infrastructure Monitoring
modules.summary: Metric collection, health and capacity monitoring for physical, virtual and containerized servers.

modules.name: Log Management and Analytics
modules.summary: Central log collection, parsing, retention tiers and search across the estate.

modules.name: Application Performance Monitoring
modules.summary: Transaction tracing, service dependency mapping and error analysis for instrumented applications.

customer_slots.customer_name: Full legal/customer-facing name of the prospect
customer_slots.proposal_date: Date the proposal is issued (DD Month YYYY)
customer_slots.prepared_by: Verto Wave entity preparing the proposal
customer_slots.site_count: Number of sites in scope (e.g. '28 branches across Egypt')
customer_slots.compliance_frameworks: Customer-specific regulatory/compliance frameworks to call out (e.g. CBE, FRA, education-sector)
customer_slots.devicex_qty_note: Optional note about hardware quantity basis (e.g. 'to be confirmed via site survey')
customer_slots.esg_footprint: One-line description of the customer's distributed footprint (e.g. 'one of the largest educational networks in Egypt, serving millions of students across thousands of schools')
customer_slots.esg_value_1: First value statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'digital classrooms and e-learning')
customer_slots.esg_value_2: Second value statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'streamlined administrative operations')
customer_slots.esg_outcome: Outcome statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'data-driven insights for decision-making')
customer_slots.esg_example_a: First illustrative example for the executive summary (e.g. 'nationwide e-assessment platforms')
customer_slots.esg_example_b: Second illustrative example for the executive summary (e.g. 'connected schools and digital content repositories')
customer_slots.scope_services_description: One-line description of the services in scope (e.g. 'datacentres, backend systems, and school infrastructure')
customer_slots.deployment_context: What is being rapidly deployed (e.g. 'new business locations', 'new branch locations', 'new school sites')
customer_slots.objective_1: First acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Accelerate branch/school/site deployment')
customer_slots.objective_4: Fourth acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Implement on-demand virtual workloads')
customer_slots.objective_5: Fifth acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Host business-critical applications locally')
customer_slots.proposal_version: Proposal version identifier for the change-history table (e.g. '1.0')
customer_slots.proposal_status: Proposal status for the change-history table (e.g. 'Draft', 'For Review', 'Approved', 'Submitted')
customer_slots.proposal_date_iso: Proposal date in YYYY-MM-DD form for the change-history table (e.g. '2026-09-02')
customer_slots.author_name: Author name for the change-history table (e.g. 'VertoWave Proposal Team')
customer_slots.proposal_title: Proposal title on the cover page (e.g. 'DeviceX Branch-in-a-Box and StackX Operations Platform')
customer_slots.proposal_subtype: Cover document type, after 'Technical Proposal —' (e.g. 'DeviceX/SDX & StackX' or 'Professional Services')
customer_slots.ola_latency_target: SD-WAN target: one-way latency for priority media (e.g. '150 ms')
customer_slots.ola_jitter_target: SD-WAN target: jitter for priority media (e.g. '30 ms')
customer_slots.ola_loss_target: SD-WAN target: packet loss for priority media (e.g. '1%')
customer_slots.ola_mos_target: SD-WAN target: voice quality as a MOS score (e.g. '4.0')
customer_slots.ola_video_target: SD-WAN target: session video quality (e.g. '720p at 30 fps')
customer_slots.ola_failover_target: SD-WAN target: overlay failover time (e.g. '1 second')
customer_slots.ola_bringup_target: SD-WAN target: zero-touch site bring-up time (e.g. '30 minutes')
customer_slots.services_branches: Professional Services: number of branches / sites
customer_slots.services_network_devices: Professional Services: network devices to be monitored
customer_slots.services_apps_monitored: Professional Services: applications to be monitored
customer_slots.services_endpoints: Professional Services: endpoints to roll out
customer_slots.services_tunnels: Professional Services: SD-WAN tunnels / overlay connections
customer_slots.services_catalog_items: Service catalog items and request workflows in scope
customer_slots.services_discovery_sources: Discovery sources for the configuration model
customer_slots.services_monitored_hosts: Hosts and services to be instrumented
customer_slots.services_arch_diagrams: Professional Services: architecture diagrams to be produced
customer_slots.customer_profile: Short profile of the customer for the executive summary — can be drafted by Hermes and must be approved by a person
customer_slots.requirement_summary: Two or three sentences restating what the customer has asked for (Understanding of the Requirement)
customer_slots.key_requirements: The RFP's main requirements, one per line starting with '- ' (Understanding of the Requirement)
customer_slots.timeline_design_weeks: Implementation timeline: envisioning and design, in weeks
customer_slots.timeline_core_weeks: Implementation timeline: core build, in weeks
customer_slots.timeline_pilot_weeks: Implementation timeline: pilot site, in weeks
customer_slots.timeline_rollout_weeks: Implementation timeline: site roll-out, in weeks
customer_slots.timeline_stackx_weeks: Implementation timeline: StackX implementation, in weeks
customer_slots.timeline_training_weeks: Implementation timeline: training and handover, in weeks
customer_slots.support_term_months: Software support and maintenance term, in months from license delivery (e.g. '12')
customer_slots.hardware_warranty_months: DeviceX hardware warranty against manufacturing defects, in months (e.g. '12')
customer_slots.support_coverage: Support coverage hours (e.g. '8x5, Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 5 PM local time')
customer_slots.ola_l1_engineers: Staffing for L1 operations engineers, e.g. '2 on site'
customer_slots.ola_l1_manager: Staffing for the L1 operations manager, e.g. '1 on site'
customer_slots.ola_l2_engineers: Staffing for L2 operations engineers, e.g. '1 on site'
customer_slots.licenses_coverage_term: Coverage carried by each licensed module, e.g. '36-month subscription with support and updates'
